analysis.summary: Depth, search completion, UCI options and result parsing
analysis.contract: Publish only completed current-position results at the actual requested depth with the attainable candidate count.

accuracy.summary: Range targeting, strength override and suggestion styles
accuracy.contract: Target the range and nearest priority by default; styles apply near priority. Preserve explicit safety, opening/book and mate rules. No additional search.

openings.summary: Protected opening window and validated book candidates
openings.contract: Fullmoves1–10 protected. Book hits must be current scored roots within0.25 pawns and tighter active limits.

arrows.summary: Suggestion readiness, rendering, coordinates and window lifecycle
arrows.contract: Renderer and AutoMove share the selected candidate. Arrow window stays click-through and follows streamproof state.

streamproof.summary: Windows capture exclusion for GUI, visualizer and arrows
streamproof.contract: F5 applies ON and OFF to the separate arrow HWND; remap/rebuild inherits current state. Linux API mocks do not verify actual capture.

ui.summary: Native Tk sidebar, controls, variables and callbacks
ui.contract: Tk control panel, not a web app. Keep controls, overlay state, persisted settings and descriptive status synchronized.

settings.summary: Setting defaults, migration, save/load and atomic writer
settings.contract: New setting: update default, collect/apply, control variable and sync path. Keep user settings and credentials out of bundles.

bridge.summary: Extension FEN/game context to Python WebSocket/UI queue
bridge.contract: Reject stale board/result epochs; GUI state flows through Tk queue. No live-site test is implied by syntax or local mocks.

automove.contract: Use the same ready suggestion as arrows; no raw-best fallback bypassing depth/policy.

timing.summary: Optional primary-engine depth timer and new-match reset
timing.contract: Completed searches only in averages; cache hits and incomplete searches separate; new match resets counts, not toggle.
